config.monkeycraft.title: MonkeyCraft Configuration
config.monkeycraft.option.autoLaunch.too: Automatically start the WebSocket server when joining a game
config.monkeycraft.option.port.tooltip: The port number for the MonkeyCraft server (1-65535)
config.monkeycraft.option.password.toolt: Password for authentication (leave empty to keep current)
config.monkeycraft.option.commandAllowli: List of allowed command patterns. Use '*' for wildcard (e.g., 'warp *' allows '/warp anything')

config.monkeycraft.option.defaultBehavio: What to do when a command is not in allowlist or denylist. Use 'ALLOW' or 'DENY'

MonkeyCraft Commands:
